passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 52 Noes Count 18 NVR Count 10

passages.provision_quote: (c) It is the policy of the state to do both of the following: (1) Achieve net zero greenhouse gas emissions as soon as possible, but no later than 2045, and to achieve and maintain net negative greenhouse gas emissions thereafter. This goal is in addition to, and does not replace or supersede, the statewide greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets in Section 38566. (2) Ensure that by 2045, statewide anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 85 percent below the statewide greenhouse gas emissions limit established pursuant to Section 38550.
passages.note: Declares a net-zero/emissions-limit policy and directs carbon capture/removal strategies; names no clean-energy mandate (H17).

rows.reasoning: Lee voted Aye on AB 1279 (2021-2022), the California Climate Crisis Act, which declares a policy of net zero (and later net negative) greenhouse gas emissions by 2045 and directs the state to implement carbon dioxide removal and carbon capture, utilization, and storage strategies. Per V4.2 (H17), an emissions-limit/net-zero declaration that names carbon capture and removal as paths names no energy source and can be met other ways, so it shows only the pro-climate-action side, not rung 1's clean-energy mandate — BLANK direction-only.
